cotreatment.note: paired read on fold 0 only: the round-1 fields are the treated models; the round-0 fields on the same rows are the control; both are out-of-fold for fold 0's segments

caveats: Simulator truth is the mapped catalogue minus visible; relative instrument only (Spearman(reported, simulated DTI) = -0.1045, knowledge/10 s5).
The pinned inputs are owner-mirror SHA-verified, not organizer-authenticated.
The hide-mode OOF fields never saw the held whole segments; on the tip instrument the same fields are conservative (fold components hidden at fit).
A required-novel arm cannot be scored by this simulator at all (knowledge/18 s6); pooled DTI here measures the field's ranking on catalogue truth, not the hidden competition truth.
